          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/preparing_to_launch",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/preparing_to_launch.json",
          "text": "Place these items in the inventory of your rocket, and ensure that you always have them every time you launch a rocket. Finally, you should bring multiple full gas tanks, plentiful food, soul torches or glowstone (normal torches will burn out), weapons and tools. Once you have this, you are ready to launch! Enter the rocket and press !",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Preparing to Launch",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/the_moon",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/the_moon.json",
          "text": "The Moon",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "The Moon",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/the_moon",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/the_moon.json",
          "text": "The Moon",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "The Moon",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/the_moon",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/the_moon.json",
          "text": "Congratulations on reaching the moon! The moon is a barren wasteland, grey and dead, as far as the eye can see; however, underground is where you will find the next major resource in Ad Astra - Desh! Desh is used to craft advanced machines, space stations, and the tier two rocket.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "The Moon",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/the_moon",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/the_moon.json",
          "text": "The environment",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "The Moon",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/the_moon",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/the_moon.json",
          "text": "The environment of the moon is very different from earth. As the moon has no oxygen and is freezing, attempting to place water will freeze it and lit blocks like torches will break. Any plant life and crops will also die very quickly. To combat these effects, you can build an oxygen distributor, which will we cover later.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "The Moon",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/the_moon",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/the_moon.json",
          "text": "Returning Home",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "The Moon",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/the_moon",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_first_launch/the_moon.json",
          "text": "To return back to earth, open your lander (shift + right-click) and collect the rocket, fuel and the launch pad. To remove the lander, punch it. Set up the launch pad, place the rocket down and fill it up with fuel. Press and fly back to earth.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "The Moon",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 3
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/jet_suit",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/jet_suit.json",
          "text": "Jet Suit",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Jet Suit",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/jet_suit",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/jet_suit.json",
          "text": "Jet Suit",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Jet Suit",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/jet_suit",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/jet_suit.json",
          "text": "The Jet Suit is an upgraded version of the Netherite Space Suit, with more protection, additional oxygen storage, and flight. It's expensive to craft, but it offers high-speed flight, making travel easy.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Jet Suit",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/jet_suit",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/jet_suit.json",
          "text": "It's got two modes of flight: ascending () and boosted ( + ). Ascending makes the wearer fly upwards, while boosted is similar to an elytra that's constantly being propelled by fireworks. The Jet Suit is powered by energy and must be charged to fly. It can be charged with an energizer by right-clicking it with the jet suit. Enable/disable the suit by pressing ().",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Jet Suit",
          "item_ref_count": 6,
          "recipe_ref_count": 2,
          "count": 4
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/proxima_centauri",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/proxima_centauri.json",
          "text": "Proxima Centauri",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Proxima Centauri",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/proxima_centauri",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/proxima_centauri.json",
          "text": "Proxima Centauri",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Proxima Centauri",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/proxima_centauri",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/proxima_centauri.json",
          "text": "Once you have found enough Calorite to craft a tier four rocket, you will be able to leave this solar system and enter a new one. The first planet that you will head to in Proxima Centauri is Glacio. Glacio is brutally cold; however, it has oxygen, allowing you to survive there without a spacesuit.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Proxima Centauri",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/proxima_centauri",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_hot_planets/proxima_centauri.json",
          "text": "This is the end of the Ad Astra progression for now. This guidebook will be expanded as more content is added. Thanks for playing Ad Astra!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Proxima Centauri",
          "item_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/cables",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/cables.json",
          "text": "Cables allow for long-range energy transfer. There are two variants: steel and desh – desh, having a higher transfer rate. When used with a wrench, cables can be configured to extend in directions or to disconnect from nodes in the network.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Cables",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/cables",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/cables.json",
          "text": "Cable ducts",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Cables",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/cables",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/cables.json",
          "text": "Cables are not solid blocks. As such, they will not seal a structure which prevents oxygen distributors and gravity normalizers from functioning. The cable duct is a full block that works exactly like cables while preventing leaks.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Cables",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/lunarians",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/lunarians.json",
          "text": "Throughout the moon, There are large, inhabited underground villages. These villages contain an alien form of the earth villager, who call themselves Lunarians. Unlike their earth counterpart, Lunarian don't need oxygen and can survive the chilling environment of the moon.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Lunarians",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/lunarians",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/lunarians.json",
          "text": "Lunarian have different trades than earth villagers, featuring planet-specific materials, space suits and oxygen gear.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Lunarians",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/lunarians",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/lunarians.json",
          "text": "Wandering Trader",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Lunarians",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/lunarians",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/lunarians.json",
          "text": "Lunarian Wandering Traders appear on every moon and planet. They have many rocket-related trades that may save your life, including launch pads, oxygen, fuel, soul torches and water. They accept emeralds, which are commonly found in the various structures on the moon and planets.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Lunarians",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/lunarians",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/lunarians.json",
          "text": "Wandering Trader",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.name",
          "label": "Lunarians",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "count": 5
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/mars",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/mars.json",
          "text": "Now that you have explored the moon and worked with desh, you want to take it further and go to the red planet. Building a tier two rocket capable of travelling to Mars is similar to building the tier one rocket, but with desh materials instead of steel. Construct the parts, build the rocket in the NASA workbench, fuel it up, and off you go to Mars!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Mars",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/mars",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/mars.json",
          "text": "Ostrum is the next material that you seek on the red planet. It is used to craft more powerful space armour, build exceptional machines and to construct a rocket capable of withstanding extreme heat, allowing you to travel to hot planets.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Mars",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 2
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "The oxygen distributor is a powerful machine that distributes oxygen in a sealed room, allowing any life inside to survive. It works exactly like an oxygen loader, where you insert water into the tank, but instead of giving you oxygen, the oxygen is distributed into the air.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "Water Pump",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "The water pump is essential for keeping the oxygen distributor running infinitely. To use it, place an infinite water source below, then place the water pump above one of the water blocks, and then place the oxygen distributor adjacent to it. Make sure to supply both the pump and the oxygen distributor with sufficient power.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "Distributor and Pump",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "Using the Distributor",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "Once you have supplied the oxygen distributor with an infinite water source, sufficient energy and a completely sealed room, it will distribute oxygen in that room. To check that oxygen is being distributed, click \"show\" in the distributor GUI. If the room is highlighted, that means that the oxygen has been successfully distributed.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "If there is a hole in your structure that is causing oxygen to escape, the distributor GUI will provide a warning. Patch the hole to avoid unnecessary power draw and oxygen usage. After that, you should be able to take off your oxygen suit and survive. Each oxygen distributor can support up to 6,000 blocks, allowing you to build a moderately sized space station or base. If you need more, you can place more oxygen distributors.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "Inside your oxygenated structure, you should provide proper ventilation to ensure that oxygen does not get blocked when a door is closed. To do this, you can create a one-block gap in between walls or use a vent block to allow oxygen flow.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "Rapid depressurization",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.title",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/oxygen_distributor.json",
          "text": "When your structure is fully sealed, and a hole is created, your structure will rapidly depressurize. This can be a catastrophic event. All entities inside will be violently sucked out of the hole and die without a space suit. The oxygen distributor will also rapidly drain oxygen and power. Avoid this by patching holes as soon as possible and by preventing accidental holes from being created.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Oxygen Distributor",
          "item_ref_count": 5,
          "recipe_ref_count": 1,
          "count": 7
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/entries/the_moon/rover",

          "text": "The world of Beneath is a lot like the underworld that you are familiar with, but in the style of TerraFirmaCraft.           "text": "Cables are not solid blocks. As such, they will not seal a structure which prevents oxygen distributors and gravity normalizers from functioning. The cable duct is a full block that works exactly like cables while preventing leaks.",

          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This unlocks unique Batteries that are far superior to their standard counterparts.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Home-grown batteries",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HV Autoclave",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The HV Chemical Bath is used to dye Lenses using Chemical Dye. This will let you engrave more types of Wafers, and cool other kinds of Hot Ingots.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Please don't bathe with your toaster...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "High Voltage Bathing",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You now have access to two new Maintenance Hatches.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Automatic Maintenance Hatch is pretty simple - it eliminates the need for Maintenance, forever.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Configurable Maintenance Hatch is more interesting. You can configure it to cut off 10%% duration on recipes, at the cost of making Maintenance happen three times as fast. That is 16 real hours of activity. Additionally, you can use it on Multiblock Generators to increase the duration of the recipe, which indirectly increases their fuel efficiency by 10%%!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Reminder: You can put Tape in the maintenance Hatch to automatically fix problems.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: The Automatic Maintenance Hatch texture and mechanic comes from TecTech, an addon mod originally made for GregTech: New Horizons.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You'll see more from TecTech if you stick with us with the late game.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "I have become maintenance, eater of tape",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Advanced Maintenance",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Just like MV, you'll need to make higher-tier components.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The painful Flawless Gems have been replaced with slightly-more-painful Vitrified Ender Pearls. Also notice that the Motors require 2x Silver Cables.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Hulls and Machines use Gold Cables.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Finally, a use for that stockpile of Gold!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Tips to make life less painful:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Use Electrotine decomposition and Ore Processing for Electrum.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Use the Chemical Bath with Mercury for Gold and Silver from a wide variety of ores.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "We call this \"fun\"",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "High Voltage Components",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The HV Assembler is the next step in progression, but also unlocks a handful of useful utilities - check around this quest for more.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You will need this HV Assembler to make your Rocket.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HV Assembler",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You'll want to grab these two lenses. The Simple System on Chip will be used for the best ULV Circuit recipe, while the LPIC Wafer is required for your next Energy Hatch.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "I see the world in colour",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "ULV Circuits are used in some AE2 recipes and Create recipes.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Best ULV circuits!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Low Power Integrated Circuit requires an HV Cutter inside your Cleanroom.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HV Energy Hatches will be nice additions so you can run your Multiblocks (mainly your Electric Blast Furnace and Large Chemical Reactor) directly off a HV line.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Noticing a pattern here?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Upgrade your EBF II",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The HV Chemical Reactor unlocks a ton of new recipes. Ah, who doesn't love the ever-growing demand on more advanced Chemistry?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: We've actually unlocked a ton of new content by reaching HV. However, not every processing line or item is crucial right now. It'd make the HV chapter far too dense if we included everything!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You could still check out the EV Chapter if you want to push yourself.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "High Voltage Chemistry",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Titanium requires a slightly more involved process than the previous materials to process. To get started, you'll need Rutile, which can be obtained by processing Ilmenite that you can get from Bauxite, Aluminium, Armalcolite and Desh, which can be found in massive quantities on The Moon.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Once you've gotten enough Rutile, your journey to Titanium continues in the next quest. There's no need to rush things.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Tip: Ore processing for Bauxite is ridiculously good! It can easily triples your Rutile yield.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "...means it WASN'T Titanium!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Almost Titanium",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "To get your grubby hands on some Titanium, Rutile must first be reduced to Titanium Tetrachloride in an HV Chemical Reactor, then reduced again in an EBF with Magnesium to finally arrive at Titanium.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Carbon, Chlorine, Oxygen, and Magnesium used in the process can be perfectly recovered from the byproduct Carbon Monoxide and Magnesium Chloride with no loss. If you set up a system to recover them, the only material that you'll need to provide for Titanium is Rutile!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Titanium Tetrachloride also acts as a catalyst in the production of plastics. A touch of TiCl₄ in the polymerisation process can increase the polymer yield to 133%%. Naturally, this is completely optional.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Is it titanium yet?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Click here to complete this quest/task",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Almost Titanium²",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }
      ],
      "aliases": []
    },

          "id": "ad_astra:astrodux/en_us/categories/surviving_mars",
          "source": "jar:ad_astra-forge-1.20.1-1.15.20.jar!assets/ad_astra/patchouli_books/astrodux/en_us/categories/surviving_mars.json",
          "text": "You've landed on Mars with one goal in mind - to mine as much ostrum as possible to get to Venus and Mercury.",
          "key": "guide-page:description",
          "label": "Surviving Mars",
          "item_ref_count": 1
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You’ve built new chemistry lines, manufactured advanced alloys, and even launched a Rocket to reach the Moon. We hope you enjoyed the ride, because now things get even more complex, with powerful new machines and demanding processes ahead.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "In the EV Chapter, your main objective will be to craft your very first IV and LuV Circuits.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Along the way, several key challenges await you:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "• Build your first Alloy Blast Smelter, a faster version of the EBF, specialized for alloys. With it, you’ll be able to construct your first Large Machine: the Large Centrifuge, essential for the Nuclear Fission Line. It also lets you upgrade ore processing with a faster Thermal Centrifuge.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "• Master our original Tungsten Line - looping all the required materials will test both your knowledge and your patience.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "• Prepare to fly to Mars where you’ll become an extraterrestrial farmer while also learning to harness the power of the atom.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Good luck, this is where GregTech begins to show its true depth!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Let's go Nuclear on Mars",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This is Extreme Voltage",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This new rocket shouldn’t be too difficult to assemble, but you’ll notice a clear jump in material costs compared to your previous model.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The upgraded Rocket Alloys now require both Distilled Water and Cryogenized Fluix for cooling.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Make sure you've fully set up your Titanium production line, as you're going to need a lot of it going forward! A continuous production line will save you a lot of frustration down the road.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This one's purple",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(ad_astra:tier_2_rocket)item(tfg:tier_2_double_rocket))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Either rocket",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Rocket 2: Titanium Boogaloo",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "First, like the Moon, Mars will have some hostile surface mobs as well. If you haven't already figured out how to make your Space Suit stay with you after dying or invested in new EV-tier weaponry, you'll have a rough time.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The planet is mostly a desert world, dotted with \"islands\" where you’ll find water, lush fauna, and much safer places to build your first base. Meanwhile, the open desert is extremely dangerous if you don't watch your step, but contains some other crucial resources!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "All fluid veins are spread across Mars, except for Heavy Ammoniacial Water which can only be found outside of the desert. That’s another good reason to set up your base there.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Energy-wise, Mars will not be kind to you at first.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Nearly every common energy generation method is disabled or worthless on the planet, which means you’ll have to rely almost entirely on Fission to power your base.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "At the very beginning, we recommend bringing along some filled batteries such as Lapotron Crystals to get started, and then look towards setting up Thorium Fuel Rods.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Achieving energy stability on Mars will take time and effort, but once your systems are running smoothly, you’ll feel like unlimited power is right in the palm of your hand.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "And one last tip: don’t kill everything you see. Some animals can be ranched, and you’ll definitely need them later in your progression.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Be sure to check out the Space Survival chapter for more Mars-related tips too!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Stay alert, plan ahead, and Mars will reward your courage.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Red Planet",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Land on Mars",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "I'm on Mars!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Congrats on making your first Tungsten! We hope you enjoy this small increase in complexity. Remember that, at first, the small amount of Tungsten you require can be achieved by simply inputting the Soda Ash you mined. This may inspire you to fully loop the process so you can automate it peacefully.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Also remember that the further you progress, the more important it will be to build dedicated and passive lines for all these complex processes that will be required until the end of the pack. Don’t be afraid of lacking resources, be afraid of lacking time.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Fully self-sustaining, just like Titanium",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "one_completed",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Tungsten Line in TerraFirmaGreg has been completely reworked and you’ll be happy (or not) to know that it’s now much harder.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "It’s possible to fully loop every material in the Tungsten Line, but doing so requires a lot of engineering. Alternatively, you can brute-force your way through by mass-producing the resources you need.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "A little tip: Mars has several good ore veins for Soda Ash and Tungsten.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Take your time, optimize, and the Tungsten Line will become the foundation of your mid-to-late game progress.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Why? Just why?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The new Tungsten Line",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "all_started",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You know what to do with this by now, but this is a good time to give you a heads up that now is the time to scale up your factory if you haven't already done so.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Take your time to set up AE2 all over your base, making it print you dozens of new machines to keep your factory running at tip-top shape, because if you don't, the rest of EV is going to hit you like a brick wall.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Don't wait to find out the hard way!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "At the very least, here's what we recommend before pushing further into EV:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Passive production of Rubber, Polyethylene, Oxygen, Hydrogen, Nitrogen, and Chlorine",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- At least two general-purpose EBFs, and a few LCRs",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- AE2 patterns for a circuit of every tier and most of the common crafting components like motors, pumps, plates, and wires",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- A dedicated ore processing setup",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- A couple EV amps worth of power generation (see the below quests)",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You can do it, you've made it this far already!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Last step before some Extreme power generation!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "EV Assembler",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Distillation Tower (DT) is a direct multiblock upgrade of the Distillery. You won't have to choose outputs any more as the DT will handle them all automatically, at an increased power cost.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This machine will be your future bread and butter for anything involving Petrochem or Organic distillation.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Like the Cleanroom, the DT can be made taller, though not wider. Starting from the second layer, each added level requires an Output Hatch and grants one additional fluid output slot; if a level lacks its output hatch, the corresponding fluid will be voided. Count the number of outputs with EMI so you know how many layers you need. As always, use the Multiblock Preview tab in EMI and click the multiblock to see where you can place each part.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }
      ],

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You’ve built new chemistry lines, manufactured advanced alloys, and even launched a Rocket to reach the Moon. We hope you enjoyed the ride, because now things get even more complex, with powerful new machines and demanding processes ahead.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "In the EV Chapter, your main objective will be to craft your very first IV and LuV Circuits.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
